title: 列車自動防護系統
summary: 列車自動防護系統以「制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。列車自動防護把速度位置、路線許可及制動能力組成可持續檢查的包絡，離線算例只解釋邊界，不能作可上線的安全控制器。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Automatic train protection combines speed/location, movement authority and braking capability into a continuously checked envelope; offline examples explain boundaries rather than forming a deployable safety controller. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=726 m。模型邊界：水平常減速度且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s；y=v*t=36 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=39.6 m。模型邊界：延遲期間速度固定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=726 m. Boundary: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s; y=v*t=36 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=39.6 m. Boundary: Fixed speed during the delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 常減速度停距與處理延遲行程
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「常減速度停距」與「處理延遲行程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Constant-deceleration stop distance" and "Processing-delay travel": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 常減速度停距：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Constant-deceleration stop distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「常減速度停距」如何影響列車自動防護系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Constant-deceleration stop distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train protection systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動能關係使停距隨速度平方增長。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 726 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水平常減速度且無建立延遲。使用速度衰減與制動建立作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「常減速度停距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy balance makes stopping distance grow with speed squared. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 726 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay. Use speed decay and brake build-up as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Constant-deceleration stop distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 常減速度停距：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「常減速度停距」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Constant-deceleration stop distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=726 m。模型邊界：水平常減速度且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=726 m. Boundary: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以速度衰減與制動建立區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度軌跡與時間積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed decay and brake build-up to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「常減速度停距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Constant-deceleration stop distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以速度衰減與制動建立區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度軌跡與時間積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「常減速度停距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed decay and brake build-up to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed trace and time integration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Constant-deceleration stop distance. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance. Explain which evidence in speed decay and brake build-up distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 常減速度停距：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「常減速度停距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Constant-deceleration stop distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求。這個失效與「常減速度停距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查速度衰減與制動建立，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
